facts.business: Puravankara Limited is a real estate developer operating across India with four brands — Puravankara (luxury/premium residential), Provident Housing (premium affordable housing), Purva Land (plotted developments), and Purva Streaks (end-to-end interior solutions) — and has delivered 95 projects covering 57.36 million sq. ft. as of March 31, 2026.
